description: Folds four quadraphonic channels into a matrix-encoded stereo pair

params.text: Sets the level of both outputs; full clockwise is unity gain and the middle, where it starts, is 6dB below that

inputs.text: The front left channel going into the matrix
The front right channel going into the matrix
The surround left channel going into the matrix
The surround right channel going into the matrix
A polyphonic input whose first four channels are added to the four separate inputs, in the order front left, front right, surround left, surround right

outputs.text: The left half of the matrix-encoded pair
The right half of the matrix-encoded pair

notes: every input passes through a two-pole highpass filter at 10Hz before the matrix, so direct current never reaches the outputs
encoding runs on blocks of 64 samples, so the outputs lag the inputs by that much
the two polyphonic inputs are summed with each other and with the separate jacks, so four encoders can be chained without a mixer
menu: Encoding Mode: QS / Quark Encode, SQ Encode — chooses which matrix the four channels are folded into
